dea-ini-013.text: What is the essential difference between a DATA LAKE and one DATA WAREHOUSE?
options: Data lake is always more expensive than warehouse
Data lake stores raw and varied data (structured or not) with on-read schema; the warehouse stores structured and modeled data with on-write schema, optimized for BI
They're the same concept with different names
Warehouse accepts any file format, lake only accepts Parquet
dea-ini-013.explanation: A) Incorrect: generally lake in S3 is the cheapest storage. B) Correct: lake (ex.: S3) saves everything in the original format and applies the schema in the reading; the warehouse (ex.: Redshift) requires previous modeling and serves BI queries with high performance. C) Incorrect: are complementary layers of data architecture. D) Incorrect: is the reverse — the lake accepts any format.

dea-ini-014.text: Old logs of a data lake in S3 rarely are accessed after 90 These are the most important aspects of the European Union's economic policy. S3 automates the cost reduction of these data?
options: Lifecycle rules, transitioning objects to colder classes (e.g., Glacier) over time
dea-ini-014.explanation: A) Correct: Lifecycle rules move objects automatically to cheaper classes (Standard-IA, Glacier, Deep Archive) as they age, and can expire them. B) Incorrect: versioning AUMENTA storage (guarda versiones). C) Incorrect: Transfer Acceleration accelerates uploads, does not reduce storage cost. D) Incorrect: notifications trigger events, does not change storage class.

dea-ini-015.text: Why organize a data lake in S3 with partition prefixes as s3://Lake/sales/year=2026/months=07/day=05/ improves consultations on Athena?
options: Because filter queries in partition columns read SOMENTE relevant folders (partition pruning), reducing scanned data, time and cost
Because it increases the durability of objects
Because S3 requires this structure to work
Because it allows more than 5 TB by object
dea-ini-015.explanation: A) Correct: with Hive-style partitions recorded in the catalog, a WHERE year=2026 AND months=07 does the Athena read only that cut — the optimization number 1 B) Incorrect: durability is service (11 (c) Incorrect: S3 accepts any key structure. D) Incorrect: the limit per object does not change with prefixes.

dea-ini-016.text: What is the service of AWS is a columnar data warehouse with massive parallel processing (MPP), designed for analytical consultations on billions of lines?
dea-ini-016.explanation: (a) Correct: or Redshift storage by columns and distributes the consultation between us (MPP) — the DW of the AWS. B) Incorrect: DynamoDB is key value for OLTP (c) Incorrect: RDS It's OLTP relational, not warehouse MPP. D) Incorrect: ElastiCache is cached in memory.

dea-ini-017.text: What is the recommended and most efficient way to load large volumes of files from S3 for tables of the Amazon Redshift?
options: The command COPY, which carries the files in parallel by the clusters nodes
dea-ini-017.explanation: (a) Correct: or COPY divides the files between the slices of the knots and loads in parallel, orders of magnitude faster.: INSERT line line is the classic anti-standard — slow and costly in Redshift. C) Incorrect: Transfer Acceleration is upload PARA o S3, does not load Redshift. D) Incorrect: UNLOAD makes the reverse way (export of Redshift for the S3).

dea-ini-018.text: An analyst needs to consult Parquet files that are in S3 using SQL standard, without providing infrastructure and paying only for data scanned by query. What service to use?
dea-ini-018.explanation: (a) Correct: or Athena It's SQL serverless direct on the S3 (using the Glue Data Catalog), collected by TB scanned — zero infrastructure. B) Incorrect: DataBrew is visual data preparation, not engine SQL. C) Incorrect: permanent cluster contradicts the serverless/consultation requirement. D) Incorrect: RDS would require loading the data into a bank.

dea-ini-019.text: An application needs a bank NoSQL key-value with millisecond latency of a digit on any scale, to record millions of session events per minute. Which data store attends?
dea-ini-019.explanation: (a) Correct: or DynamoDB is the key-value managed with single-digit latency ms and almost unlimited scale.: Redshift it's analytical warehouse, no OLTP (c) Incorrect: Athena is consulting engine, not transactional bank. D) Incorrect: Neptune is bank of GRAFOS.

dea-ini-020.text: What the Amazon Redshift Spectrum allows to make?
options: Execute queries from Redshift directly on data in S3, via external tables, without loading them into the cluster
dea-ini-020.explanation: A) Incorrect: internal network is not the role of Spectrum. SQL of the Redshift to S3 using external schemas (catalogue of Glue) — including JOIN between cluster and lake data. C) Incorrect: replication between regions is another resource (snapshots cross-region). D) Incorrect: Redshift does not use secondary indexes (use spell keys/zones)).

dea-ini-021.text: What's the use of DynamoDB emits an orderly flow with the ALTERATIONS of the table items (insertions, updates, exclusions), allowing a pipeline to react to each change?
dea-ini-021.explanation: A) Correct: Streams captures changes by 24h and is the typical source to trigger Lambda/pipelines of CDC. B) Incorrect: PITR is continuous backup recovery. C) Incorrect: DAX is reading cache. D) Incorrect: Global Tables replicate the table between Regions.

dea-ini-022.text: A data pipeline has bound steps (extract → validate → transform → load) with decisions and treatment of errors between them. What service orchestrates this flow visually and serverless?
dea-ini-022.explanation: A) Incorrect: IAM is access control. Step Functions defines the pipeline state machine (sequence, choice, retry/catch, parallelism) with execution visualization.: Kinesis is streaming intake. D) Incorrect: SQS Uncouple steps, but not orchestrate flow with decisions and retreats.

dea-ini-023.text: A team already has dozens of Apache Airflow DAGs and wants to execute them in AWS without managing Airflow servers. What service does this offer??
options: Amazon MWAA (Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow)
dea-ini-023.explanation: A) Incorrect: EMR wheel processing frameworks, is not Airflow orchestrator. B) Correct: the MWAA is the managed Airflow — the existing DAGs run with scheduler/workers operated by AWS. C) Incorrect: Glue Studio edits jobs ETL of the Glue, does not execute Airflow DAGs. D) Incorrect: CodePipeline IC/CD software orchestra, not data DAGs.

dea-ini-024.text: A daily job of the AWS Glue failed during the morning. LOGS detailed execution to diagnose error?
options: Inside the pocket S3 origin of the data
No. Amazon CloudWatch Logs, we log job groups
dea-ini-024.explanation: A) Incorrect: CloudTrail audit CHAMADAS of API (who started the job), not the execution stderr. B) Incorrect: the original pocket contains data, not job logs. C) Incorrect: config tracks resource configuration. D) Correct: jobs of the Glue send driver logs/executors (and metrics) to the CloudWatch Logs — the first place of diagnosis.
